description: Block ciphers in ECB mode used to encrypt data at rest: Node crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-ecb'), crypto-js mode.ECB for localStorage and inline in a React (.jsx) vault page, PyCryptodome AES.MODE_ECB, the Python cryptography package's modes.ECB(), Java Cipher.getInstance("AES") (the provider default is AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding), Go's usual hand-rolled ECB (aes.NewCipher, then block.Encrypt over each 16-byte slice, no cipher mode), Ruby OpenSSL::Cipher::AES.new(256, :ECB) and OpenSSL::Cipher.new("aes-256-ecb"), and PHP openssl_encrypt/openssl_decrypt with 'aes-256-ecb'. Identical plaintext blocks encrypt to identical ciphertext. VC124 must fire on each.
